prompt: Which U.S. airline had the highest percentage of delayed flights over the full calendar year of 2024, according to the U.S. Department of Transportation's Air Travel Consumer Report?
answer: JetBlue Airways had the highest percentage of delayed flights in 2024. Its on-time arrival rate was the lowest among the major U.S. reporting carriers, so roughly 30% of its flights were delayed by 15 minutes or more.
